## About
ABP Repair is a full service repair shop for Porsche in Oakland. You may also know us as BauerWerks or Bauer Porsche. We work on everything from early air-cooled cars to the late models, and we also serve owners from our Livermore shop.
Customers tell us they come back because we explain what the car needs and what it doesn't. Whether you're keeping up with regular maintenance or chasing a problem nobody else could sort out, we'll take a careful look and give you a straight answer.
If you own a Porsche, we also encourage you to join your regional Porsche Club of America (PCA).

## Services
- Full service Porsche repair: Diagnosis and repair for Porsche owners in Oakland and around the Bay Area.
- Maintenance and upgrades: Routine maintenance to keep your Porsche running, plus upgrades and modifications.
- Air-cooled, water-cooled and late models: Classic air-cooled cars, water-cooled models and newer Porsches all come through the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on vintage Porsches?
A: Yes. Our model list starts with the 1948 Porsche 356 and runs all the way through the Cayenne.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes. Along with our Oakland shop, we have a shop in Livermore at 5948 Las Positas Rd. #H.
